Akto Atlas: Agentic AI Security for Employee Endpoints
AI Discovery Connectors

Connect Atlas to every surface where your employees run AI: CLIs, IDEs, browsers, SaaS AI suites, and the EDR/MDM tooling you already deploy through. Every connector feeds the same Agentic AI Discovery inventory: it doesn't matter which mix you pick, you get one view of everything discovered.

Start With AI Endpoint Shield

For most fleets, AI Endpoint Shield is the connector to deploy: it discovers local MCP servers, installs your CLI and IDE hooks, and bundles the System Proxy for standalone desktop apps, all through one fleet-wide rollout. Everything below either plugs into it or covers a surface it doesn't reach.

Prefer a Lighter Touch?

If you're not ready for a fleet-wide rollout, or just want to cover one specific tool on a endpoint, set these up directly:

Agentic CLI hooks, zero-install, per tool:

Claude CLI Hooks

Codex CLI Hooks

Gemini CLI Hooks

Kiro CLI Hooks

Copilot Hooks - covers GitHub Copilot in VS Code and the CLI

Snowflake Cortex Code CLI Hooks

Hermes Hooks

Amp Hooks

OpenCode Hooks

Agentic IDEs and desktop apps:

Cursor Hooks

Neovim Hooks

Claude Cowork Connector

Browser-based AI usage, a surface AI Endpoint Shield doesn't cover at all:

Browser Extensions - discovery and inline guardrails for AI usage inside Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

Already Running an EDR?

Detect AI coding tools already running on managed endpoints through the EDR you deploy, no separate agent to install:

Deploy via SentinelOne

Deploy via CrowdStrike

Deploy via Microsoft Defender Endpoint

For MDM-based rollout instead (Intune, NinjaOne, Automox, Jamf, Mosyle), see the deployment options on the AI Endpoint Shield page.

SaaS and Compliance Connectors

These pull activity data straight from the vendor's own API, no device agent required:

Anthropic Connector - pulls compliance activity from Claude.ai, Claude Console, and the Claude API via Anthropic's Compliance API.

Claude Inference Hooks - use Atlas as the security server behind Anthropic's Inference Hooks, to allow or deny Claude prompts inline before inference runs.

Grok Bot Inference Hooks (Beta) - use Atlas as the security server behind Grok Bot's Inference Hooks, to allow or deny Grok Bot prompts inline before inference runs.

OpenAI Connector - pulls audit log and org activity data from ChatGPT and OpenAI via the OpenAI Admin API.

GitHub Copilot Enterprise - agent discovery, centralized guardrails, and enterprise-wide policy enforcement for Copilot.

Copilot Studio, Copilot Studio (Multi Environment), and Copilot Studio (Threat Detection) - secure agents built in Microsoft Copilot Studio, across single or multiple Power Platform environments.

Locally Hosted Models

Atlas also discovers models served by local model runners on employee devices, including Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker Model Runner.
